hero_badge: Available for freelance, contract, and full-time opportunities, in London or internationally
what_preview_data: End-to-end Python solutions: exploratory analysis, machine learning, NLP, and data-driven insights built for clarity and real-world use.
what_desc_data: I take projects from raw data to deployed model: cleaning, feature engineering, classification, regression, NLP, and lately building AI assistants powered by the Claude API into the products themselves. I write it so both technical and non-technical people can follow what's happening and why.
what_preview_digital: I build and ship Android apps and digital products on my own, across the Google Play Store, Gumroad, Envato, and Lemon Squeezy, handling everything from the first idea to launch.
what_desc_digital: Open to freelance and contract work in data science, Python development, and digital products. I can scope a project, build it, and stick around to publish, price, and iterate based on what users actually say.
what_preview_photo: Through photography and videography, I explore architecture and urban life across different countries and cultures.
what_desc_photo: I'm drawn to how light, form, and environment reveal the character of a place: small, fleeting moments that end up feeling universal. Whether it's a still frame or something moving, I'm chasing stories that feel intimate but still land with anyone looking at them.
what_preview_design: I'm pulled toward both historic and contemporary architecture, and toward minimalist, purposeful design where form supports function and nothing is there by accident.
what_desc_design: Whether classical or modern, I'm drawn to structure, proportion, and the way thoughtful design shapes experience. I carry this approach into my work, aiming for clarity, simplicity, and considered execution.
about_p1: I'm a London-based Data Scientist and Python Developer, trained at Imperial College London (96% average). My day-to-day spans the whole data workflow: cleaning messy datasets, building and tuning models, and shipping the result as something people can actually use, not just a notebook that lives on my laptop.
about_p2: Outside client and product work, I build my own things: Android apps, trading tools, generative art systems, live wallpapers, screensavers, word-cloud typography. Fifty-plus projects so far, spread across the Google Play Store, Gumroad, Envato, and Lemon Squeezy. Running these myself taught me things a job rarely does: how to price something, when to ship versus keep polishing, and what users actually respond to once a product is out in the world.
about_p3: There's a quieter part of my life too. After major surgery and the birth of my eldest child, I started donating blood regularly, and in 2026 hit my 50th donation, recognised by NHS Blood and Transplant. It's a small, repeatable way of putting something back.
about_p4: I also write, though not often and not because I'd call myself a writer. Some thoughts just need somewhere to land. A few of those essays are published on Medium, and you can find them in the Writing section below.

d_ledgerlet: A Making Tax Digital platform for UK landlords that keeps property records and files cumulative quarterly updates straight to HMRC. Landlords add income and expenses by hand or import a bank statement CSV through a two-step preview that blocks duplicate rows. Every figure is stored as integer pence and mapped to HMRC's property headings, with joint ownership shares and mortgage interest handled the way HMRC requires. It connects to HMRC over OAuth with encrypted tokens, sends validated fraud prevention headers, checks obligations and deadlines, and keeps an append-only audit trail of every submission. Built as a modular monolith (FastAPI, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy 2.0, Alembic) with a React and TypeScript frontend whose types are generated from the API, Auth0 sign-in in the UK region, and a CI gate that runs 394 backend tests on SQLite and Postgres plus frontend unit and browser tests with accessibility checks at phone, tablet and laptop sizes. The live demo runs end to end on HMRC's sandbox.
d_voltedge: An enterprise energy intelligence platform for UK and European industrial operations. It provides real-time multi-site energy monitoring, ML anomaly detection with an isolation forest model, causal AI root-cause analysis with quantified causal strength scores, and CSRD-ready ESG reporting covering Scope 2 emissions, GRI 302-1 and carbon intensity. Includes a plain-English AI assistant powered by Claude, JWT authentication with role-based access control, and 903 passing tests. The live demo is deployed on Render.
d_voltscope: Structured extraction and deterministic validation for UK commercial energy bills, and the bill-intelligence module of VoltEdge. It accepts PDFs and phone photos (including iPhone HEIC), sends each one to Claude for schema-constrained extraction into a fixed Pydantic model, then runs a registry of independent validation checks covering MPAN digit counts, subtotal and VAT reconciliation, estimated reads, duplicate charges, contract-renewal windows and non-energy-bill detection. It ships a FastAPI review app with a drag-and-drop frontend, SQLite persistence, API-key auth and JSON, Excel and CSV export, plus a cross-portfolio layer that surfaces renewals, quantified suspected overcharges and supplier comparisons. Includes interactive OpenAPI docs, a Render deployment blueprint and 50 passing golden-file tests anchored on real, anonymised supplier bills.
d_cliniq: A B2B clinical trial site performance intelligence platform for mid-market CROs in the UK and EU. It monitors enrolment velocity, risk scores and protocol deviations across trial sites, with an AI-assisted insights layer powered by Claude. Features a FastAPI backend, a Plotly Dash dashboard and a SQLAlchemy data layer that seeds itself on startup. Built across five phases with 496 passing tests.
d_salaryaxis: A production-grade UK salary intelligence platform built on ONS open data. It aggregates Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings data, applies CPI inflation adjustment and statistical analysis, and delivers fair salary benchmarks through a REST API and a React dashboard. Features include regional breakdowns, gender pay gap trends, occupation distribution profiles and CAGR analysis, all GDPR-compliant with no personal data collected. Deployable to AWS ECS Fargate or GCP Cloud Run with a multi-stage Docker build.
d_cvlens: An NLP system that reads and analyses CVs in PDF and DOCX format. It uses spaCy for tokenisation, entity recognition and skill extraction from unstructured text, and runs automated quality checks on every result.
d_stocktracker: A real-time interactive dashboard in Python that tracks stock market data, with live price updates, key performance metrics and dynamic charts for following market movements as they happen.
d_bingomaths: A fun, bingo-style maths game for Android. Familiar bingo mechanics make practising maths engaging, and the design keeps players coming back. Free to download and play.
d_mathadventure: An adventure-based learning app for children aged 3 to 11. It combines storytelling and exploration with maths challenges to build core skills in a way that feels like play rather than study. Free to download and use.
d_monthwallpaper: A minimal, fullscreen animated live wallpaper for Android that shows the current month. Fully customisable, with multiple languages and fonts, a breathing animation and a live clock. Free to download.
d_weekdaywallpaper: A minimal, fullscreen animated live wallpaper for Android that shows the current day of the week. Supports multiple languages and fonts, with a breathing animation and a live clock. Free to download.
d_splitflap: Turns an Android phone into a living departure board. Inspired by the classic split-flap Solari boards, it shows live world clocks for multiple cities with authentic flip animations. Supports 300+ world cities and multiple colour themes. Free to download.
d_worldbuilders: Build a world from nothing and watch it grow. World Builders is an open sandbox that gives you the tools to shape the land and expand it piece by piece, at your own pace. No timers and no fixed goals, just room to create and experiment. Free to download and play.
d_searchwars: A higher-or-lower guessing game inspired by higherlowergame.com. Players see two items and guess which one gets more monthly Google searches. It has 3,187 questions across 11 categories, including Sports, Celebrity, Tech, Gaming, Geography and History, with 3 lives, high scores per category, subcategory navigation and smooth card animations. Free to play.
d_marketpulse: A clean, self-hosted economic calendar built for traders. High-impact events are highlighted first, with smart LIVE detection, automatic local time zone conversion and zero dependencies. Works fully offline as a single HTML file: no app, no subscription.
d_tradehours: Know exactly which markets are open right now. Live open and closed status for 25+ global markets, a real-time countdown to each open and close, a preloaded holiday calendar and cards you can drag to reorder. Installs as a home screen app and works fully offline, with no subscription.
d_livewallpapers: A pair of minimal, fullscreen animated wallpapers: one shows the current month, the other the current day of the week. Both are fully customisable, with 7 languages, 5 fonts, a breathing animation and a live clock. Single HTML files that work 100% offline with nothing to install. Compatible with Lively Wallpaper and Plash.
d_aeroatlas: A fullscreen screensaver for macOS and Windows styled as an airport departure board. It shows live world clocks for up to 10 cities with authentic split-flap animations, with 300+ cities to choose from, 5 accent colour themes and acoustic click sounds, and it works fully offline.
d_knok: An abstract typographic system and real-time digital clock built from pure geometric SVG, with zero dependencies in a single file. Each digit (0 to 9) is a hand-composed geometric artwork made of SVG primitives layered with CSS blend modes. Two themes, Studio Light and Gallery Dark, make the same geometry read as ink on paper or light from a projector.
d_typodigits: The digits 0 to 9 built entirely from programming and data science vocabulary. Each digit is a living word cloud, different on every load. Words are placed with canvas pixel masking, a two-gate collision system and AABB packing, then clipped by an SVG clipPath. Features breathing animations, a shimmer sweep, 3D cursor tilt and palette cycling.
d_worldmap: An interactive choropleth world map covering 172 countries across 7 data layers: population density, GDP per capita, HDI, CO₂ per capita, life expectancy, internet usage and a default view. Features region and political group filters (EU, G20, NATO, BRICS+), CSV and JSON data import, shareable URLs, iframe embedding with a JavaScript API, full keyboard navigation and dark mode, with zero dependencies in one HTML file.
d_worldcup: An interactive FIFA World Cup 2026 bracket predictor built as a single HTML file. It has a clickable knockout bracket from the round of 32, a group stage view, a champion card that traces the full route to the final, a 188-question trivia quiz across 6 categories, one-click PNG export, sharing through encoded pick URLs, dark mode, a time zone toggle and a fully responsive mobile layout. Zero dependencies, hosted on GitHub Pages.
d_orbs: An open-source JavaScript library of ten dot-formation animations: sphere, wave, spikes, network constellation, torus, double helix, spiral galaxy, loader ring, wireframe cube and k-means clusters. Any shape morphs smoothly into any other, and each has its own silhouette, drawing style and motion. Built for loaders, AI thinking states and small interactive moments. One file, about 5 KB gzipped, no dependencies, with support for reduced motion, keyboard use, and light and dark themes. Try it in the Get in Touch section below: click the orb to change its shape.
